first_step_test: One gently bowed central shaft gives the feather a clear axis and leaves room on both sides for its unequal vane.

source.notes: First sheet rejected because square output gave rectangular cells; second 3:2 landscape sheet reviewed and cropped into six square raster states.

final_elements.name: curved central shaft
final_elements.description: One continuous, slightly bowed quill rising diagonally from lower left to upper right.

final_elements.name: left vane
final_elements.description: One broad left feather edge connected at the shaft base and tapered to the existing tip.

final_elements.name: right vane
final_elements.description: One narrower right edge that returns from the same tip to the shaft base.

final_elements.name: three vane notches
final_elements.description: Three small open notches along the right edge, with short barbs turning toward the shaft.

final_elements.name: ground shadow
final_elements.description: One broken graphite shadow beneath the lower quill and vane.

frames.visible_job: Draw one rising curved shaft from lower left to upper right.
frames.instruction: Start low on the left and draw a gently bowed line toward an upper-right tip; thicken only its lower end into a short quill.

frames.visible_job: Add the broad left edge from quill base to the fixed upper tip.
frames.instruction: From the quill base, sweep one long convex edge left of the shaft and bring it into the existing upper tip.

frames.visible_job: Add the narrower right edge from tip to quill base.
frames.instruction: From that same upper tip, curve a narrower edge down the right side and return it to the quill base without moving the shaft.

frames.visible_job: Cut three small right-edge notches and draw short barbs inward.
frames.instruction: Leave three tiny gaps along the right edge and pull a few short slanted barbs from those gaps toward the shaft.

frames.visible_job: Add a broken shadow beneath the quill and lower vane.
frames.instruction: Lay a few short horizontal graphite strokes beneath the lower quill and left vane, leaving white paper between them.

final_step.visible_job: Shade existing vane and shadow without adding structure.
final_step.instruction: Use light graphite strokes from the shaft toward both edges, darken the quill and broken ground shadow, and leave narrow paper highlights.

visual_review.first_step_observation: Saved first crop shows only a curved diagonal shaft and short quill; it fixes both endpoints and leaves open paper on each side for the vanes.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: The six saved square crops retain the quill and tip at fixed anchors. The broad left vane appears in crop 2, narrow right vane in crop 3, three right-edge breaks in crop 4, and a broken shadow in crop 5. Finish shades those established forms without new structure; there are no temporary guides.

transitions.observed_addition: The curved shaft and short quill remain fixed; one broad left edge rises from the base to the same upper tip.
transitions.instruction_match: The left-vane instruction matches the newly visible long outer curve.

transitions.observed_addition: The shaft and broad left edge remain; a narrower right edge closes the vane from the same tip to the quill.
transitions.instruction_match: The right-vane instruction matches the newly enclosed asymmetric shape.

transitions.observed_addition: The quill and both vane edges remain; three small right-edge interruptions and short inward barbs break the otherwise smooth contour.
transitions.instruction_match: The notch instruction matches the three visible breaks on the right edge.

transitions.observed_addition: The feather, shaft, and three right-edge breaks remain; a soft broken graphite shadow appears beneath the lower quill and vane.
transitions.instruction_match: The ground instruction matches the new shadow placement without changing the feather.

transitions.observed_addition: All feather contours, the three notches, quill and broken shadow persist; directional graphite strokes darken the established vanes and ground.
transitions.instruction_match: The finish instruction matches shading only, with no new contour or guide removal.
